patch.summary:
Choose Freshdesk only if your buying job matches “Helpdesk and omnichannel ticketing from Freshworks — Growth from $19/agent/mo annual with ” rather than Intercom's shape. Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than Freshdesk's shape. Workflow advantage: Freshdesk leans helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support; Intercom leans live-chat-support, customer-messaging. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Freshdesk is Helpdesk and omnichannel ticketing from Freshworks — Growth from $19/agent/mo annual with 14-day trial.; Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary..
- Workflow coverage skew: Freshdesk-leaning helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support vs Intercom-leaning live-chat-support, customer-messaging, whatsapp-support.
- Researched limits: Freshdesk — No published perpetual free plan — trial-only entry for paid tiers; Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume.

Limitations — Freshdesk: No published perpetual free plan — trial-only entry for paid tiers; Freshworks suite overlap can confuse buyers choosing Freshdesk vs Freshchat vs Freshservice; Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included.

Poor-fit cases: Freshdesk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published perpetual free plan — trial-only entry for paid tiers · Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Avoid Freshdesk if you actually need Intercom's motion (Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin)
